source: claude/C3-knowledge-taxonomy-standards-survey.md (18 Oct 2026). Anchors come from summaries of CS2023 Version Gamma, the IOI Syllabus 2025 draft and Codility lessons; 'not named' statements were not full-text checked. Do not invent anchors.

tags.name: Hash Table
tags.definition: Uses a dictionary or set for constant-time lookup, counting, grouping or de-duplication as the central idea (a visited-set that only supports another technique does not count).
tags.note: CS2023 is the anchor: the IOI syllabus excludes hash tables.

tags.name: Stack & Queue
tags.definition: Uses a LIFO stack or a FIFO queue/deque to order work, match nesting, or process items in arrival order.

tags.name: Heap / Priority Queue
tags.definition: Uses a heap or priority queue to repeatedly take the smallest or largest item, or to keep the top-k.

anchor.cs2023: AL-Foundational (KA Core): Heaps and Priority Queues

tags.name: Linked List
tags.definition: Builds or manipulates nodes joined by next pointers: reversal, merging, cycle detection, pointer rewiring.

tags.name: Tree
tags.definition: Builds or processes tree-structured data: binary trees, BSTs, tries, tree traversals, parent/child relations.

anchor.ioi_2025: Balanced BSTs, segment trees, tries, tree traversals

tags.name: Array & String Manipulation
tags.definition: The core of the logic is indexing, scanning, slicing, in-place updates, matrix walks or string processing, with no more specific technique doing the work.

anchor.ioi_2025: Array manipulation; strings and string processing

tags.name: Two Pointers
tags.definition: Moves two indices through a sequence (from both ends, or at different speeds) to avoid a nested loop.

anchor.ioi_2025: not named in the parts read

tags.name: Sliding Window
tags.definition: Keeps a contiguous window over a sequence, growing and shrinking it while updating a running state.

anchor.ioi_2025: not named in the parts read

tags.name: Prefix Sum
tags.definition: Precomputes cumulative sums or counts so range queries or subarray sums take constant time.

anchor.ioi_2025: not named in the parts read

tags.name: Sorting
tags.definition: Orders the data (built-in or hand-written) as the key step, or relies on sorted order for the rest of the logic.

anchor.ioi_2025: Quicksort, quickselect, heap sort, merge sort

tags.name: Binary Search
tags.definition: Repeatedly halves a sorted or monotonic search space, including searching on the answer.

tags.name: Graph Traversal
tags.definition: Visits nodes of a graph or grid with DFS or BFS while tracking visited nodes: reachability, connected components, flood fill, unweighted shortest path.

tags.name: Advanced Graph Algorithms
tags.definition: Weighted shortest paths, minimum spanning trees, topological ordering, union-find or flow.

anchor.cs2023: AL-Foundational: shortest path, minimal spanning trees; topological sort (KA Core). Union-Find is not named.
anchor.ioi_2025: Shortest paths, MSTs, topological ordering, Union-Find, flow

tags.name: Brute Force / Enumeration
tags.definition: Tries every candidate, pair or subset exhaustively, typically with nested loops or by generating all combinations.

tags.name: Greedy
tags.definition: Makes the locally best choice at each step and never revisits it, often after sorting.

tags.name: Dynamic Programming
tags.definition: Solves overlapping subproblems by storing their results (a table or memoised recursion) and combining them.

tags.name: Recursion & Divide and Conquer
tags.definition: Solves a problem by calling itself on smaller inputs, or by splitting it into independent parts and combining the results.

tags.name: Backtracking
tags.definition: Builds a solution step by step, explores choices recursively, and undoes a choice when it leads nowhere: permutations, subsets, N-Queens.

tags.name: Math & Number Theory
tags.definition: Relies on arithmetic properties: gcd, primes, modular arithmetic, combinatorics, closed-form formulas.

anchor.cs2023: MSF-Discrete (topics not re-read in the survey)
anchor.ioi_2025: Primes, divisibility, modular arithmetic; Euclid, sieve, fast exponentiation
anchor.codility: Prime and composite numbers; Sieve of Eratosthenes; Euclidean algorithm; Fibonacci numbers

tags.name: Bit Manipulation
tags.definition: Uses bitwise operators (and, or, xor, shifts, masks) to encode state or compute the result.

anchor.ioi_2025: not found in the parts read; PF1 to PF5 not checked

tags.name: Design
tags.definition: Class or API design: objects, encapsulation, designing a data structure as a class (for example an LRU cache).
